holm_global_gate.definition: Holm-Bonferroni step-down across all three marginal KS p-values for every pair in a flow at family-wise alpha 0.01; pass if zero KS hypotheses are rejected and every pair's original coverage deviation is <= 0.10
holm_global_gate.calibrated_null_assumptions: Exact uniform marginal ranks; independent parameters and pairs; uniform location within posterior quantile gaps

size_calibrated_global_gate.definition: Test each pair's three marginal ranks with KS and each coverage level with an exact two-sided binomial test (per parameter for multi-drug, time-aware, and hierarchical flows; pooled across three parameters for continuous). Apply Holm-Bonferroni to the combined KS and coverage p-value family per flow at FWER 0.01; pass if no hypotheses are rejected.
size_calibrated_global_gate.calibrated_null_assumptions: Exact uniform marginal ranks; independent parameters and pairs; uniform location within posterior quantile gaps
